nodes.description: The homozygous insertional mutant models reduced Polr1a function. tp53 M214K produces nonfunctional DNA-binding-domain protein; the paper abbreviates this as tp53 knockout, but it is not a genomic deletion. Early apoptosis and morphology improve, while later cartilage development and survival remain abnormal. Some double mutants survive to eight rather than five days. This dose and developmental timing differ from heterozygous human disease.
